# Class `puc::ipc::RelativeChannelPath`

Canonical nonempty path relative to an absolute IPC channel namespace.

Relative paths use the same segment grammar as channel names, but omit the leading `//`. Keeping the two forms distinct prevents a caller from accidentally replacing a namespace root with an absolute child path.

[Source](../../utils/ipc/channel_path.hpp#L22)
